info.title: Cloudflare Developer Platform
info.description: Cloudflare developer platform services: artifacts, feature flags, bulk operations, snippets, and platform readiness endpoints.

get.description: Lists Artifacts namespaces for an account.

post.description: Creates an empty Artifacts namespace for an account.

get.description: Returns an Artifacts namespace summary.
Lists repositories in a namespace.

default_branch.description: Default branch name. Must not contain '..' and must not end with '/' or '.'.

post.description: Creates a Git-compatible Artifacts repository in a namespace.

default_branch.description: Git branch name. Must match /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*$/, must not contain '..', and must not end with '/' or '.'.

delete.description: Deletes a repository and schedules cleanup of its backing data.

get.description: Returns repository metadata.

default_branch.description: Default branch name. Must not contain '..' and must not end with '/' or '.'.

get.description: Returns raw bytes for an immutable Git blob object. Blob responses are cacheable forever by hash.

content-length.description: Size of the response body in bytes.

get.description: Returns decoded metadata for an immutable Git commit object. Commit responses are cacheable forever by hash.
Returns raw bytes for a file resolved by ref and path.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Git ref, branch, tag, or commit hash.

content-length.description: Size of the response body in bytes.

post.description: Forks a source repository into a new repository.
Imports an HTTPS Git repository into an Artifacts repository.

branch.description: Git branch name. Must match /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*$/, must not contain '..', and must not end with '/' or '.'.

get.description: Returns commit metadata walking backwards from a ref, branch, tag, or HEAD.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Git ref, branch, tag, or commit hash. Defaults to HEAD.

get.summary: Read a raw file with content type
get.description: Returns file bytes resolved by ref and path, with a sniffed content type and browser-safe response headers.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Git ref, branch, tag, or 40-character commit hash.

200.description: File bytes with sniffed Content-Type and browser-safe response headers.

content-length.description: Size of the response body in bytes.

get.description: Lists tokens for a repository.
Returns decoded entries for an immutable Git tree object. Tree responses are cacheable forever by hash.

post.description: Creates a scoped Git token for a repository.
Creates multiple subscriptions for an account in a single request.

get.description: Lists all apps in the account. Returns identity and audit fields only — flag definitions are not included.

post.description: Creates an app. The returned `id` is used in all subsequent flag, changelog, and evaluation requests.

delete.description: Deletes an app and all its flags and changelog history. Returns 409 if any Worker still references this app via a Flagship binding.

409.description: Conflict — app is bound to Worker scripts.

get.description: Returns an app's name and audit fields. Flag definitions are not included.

put.description: Updates an app. Only `name` is mutable.

get.description: Returns an app's evaluation-only flag definitions for SDKs that evaluate locally. Send the returned `ETag` in `If-None-Match` to avoid downloading unchanged definitions.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag for the current definitions payload.
Strong entity tag for the current definitions payload.

get.description: Evaluates a flag against the provided context. Pass context attributes as query parameters; values are forwarded as strings. For low-latency in-Worker evaluation, prefer the Flagship binding over this endpoint.

parameters.name: targetingKey
parameters.description: Context targeting key (per OpenFeature spec); used for percentage rollout bucketing.

schema.description: Context targeting key (per OpenFeature spec); used for percentage rollout bucketing.

post.description: Evaluates a flag against the provided context, passed as a JSON request body (OFREP-shaped) rather than query parameters. Returns the same response shape as the GET variant.

400.description: Missing or invalid flagKey, or malformed context.

get.description: Lists an app's flags ordered by key. Pass `cursor` from `result_info` to page forward; a null cursor indicates the last page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

schema.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

post.description: Creates a flag. Returns 409 if the key already exists. `type` is always inferred from variation values; legacy request-side values are ignored.

default_variation.description: Variation the API serves when the flag is off, or when it's on but no rule matches the context. Must be a key in `variations`.

enabled.description: When false, the flag bypasses all rules and always serves `default_variation`.

key.description: Unique identifier for the flag within an app. Used in all evaluation and SDK calls.

rules.description: Targeting rules evaluated in ascending `priority`; the first matching rule wins. An empty array means the flag always serves `default_variation`.

conditions.description: Conditions the context must satisfy for this rule to match. An empty array matches all contexts.

priority.description: Evaluation order: the API evaluates rules with lower numbers first. Must be unique across the flag's rules.

attribute.description: Context attribute used for sticky bucketing. Defaults to `targetingKey`. If absent at evaluation time, bucketing is random per request.

percentage.description: Percentage of matching traffic (0–100) served this variation. For multi-way splits, use cumulative upper bounds across rules (e.g. 30, 70, 100).

serve_variation.description: Variation the API serves when this rule matches. Must be a key in `variations`.

type.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Omit it; the API ignores this value and infers the type from the flag's variations.

variations.description: Map of variation name to value. All values share the same type (boolean, string, number, or JSON object/array), and each serialized value stays within 10KB.

delete.description: Deletes a flag permanently. Subsequent evaluations fall back to the caller-supplied default. Cannot be undone.

get.description: Returns the full flag definition including rules, variations, and audit fields.

put.description: Replaces the entire flag definition. Omitted fields are dropped, not preserved — read before writing. Each update appends a changelog entry.

get.description: Returns the audit history for a flag, newest first. Each entry includes the event type and full flag state after the change; `update` entries include a field-level diff. Capped at 200 entries per flag.

Returns the operational health status of the Cloudflare API monolith.

docs generation (see x-fern-ignore). Ref: APIOPS-12957.
